frontier.hypothesis: Class C is reachable from the FLOOR-5 SEATS (not from the flip) if some C shape makes combine_regs fail on operand 1 of RTL insn 185 without adding or deleting an instruction. This session proves the only two C-reachable gates both need an extra live use of the reload, so the remaining question is narrow and concrete: is there a spelling in which an ALREADY-PRESENT instruction consumes the reload after the add?
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc.c:1240-1298 block_alloc operand-tying loop + combine_regs gates 1 and 2 (local-alloc.c:470-478 for reg_qty, :1917 for the REG_DEAD requirement). Rows 38-64 are one basic block; the target's later uses of D_800A36A0 are all fresh reloads in later blocks.
